presentation.title: Keep the conversations you already have
presentation.body: Transcript Lake can begin with an existing Claude Code, Codex, omp, Factory Droid, or Kimi transcript store. It reads the selected vendor root without changing it, masks credential-shaped text, and persists provider-neutral events under the Lake data root.

presentation.title: Choose one discovered transcript source
presentation.body: The root is validated completely before Lake mutation. Complete malformed JSON refuses the adoption; a final line still being written is left pending. The canonical stream then masks and commits the source using each vendor file path and native runtime session id, so repeating the same adoption resumes by cursor and reports unchanged files instead of duplicating events.

presentation.title: Ask the archive its first question
presentation.body: The journey finishes only when DuckDB returns at least one row from the masked events the selected source contributed. Source selection alone is not completion.
presentation.command: transcript-lake query "SELECT runtime, count(*) AS events, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM events GROUP BY runtime ORDER BY events DESC"
